Dear Borealis Manufacturing AS,

Thank you for your revised quotation of 12.55 USD per unit with a 10-day lead time for 2,000 units of Product X.

As we finalize our decision, we would like to ask if you could offer a unit price of 11.55 USD and a lead time of 8 days for this order. These terms would significantly support our project timeline and budget considerations.

We appreciate your flexibility and look forward to your response.

Best regards,
ProcureAI Demo Buyer
